name: Cherng Talay
intro: Cherng Talay (Choeng Thale) is the subdistrict behind Bang Tao, Laguna and Layan. Its inland roads are home to many villa estates and condos that are a short drive from the beach but cost less than beachfront locations.
overview:
Cherng Talay (Choeng Thale) is a subdistrict of Thalang district that stretches from the west-coast beaches inland. In everyday use the name also covers the residential streets behind Bang Tao, Laguna and Layan, which is why several of our beach-area pages are neighbours of this one.
Projects listed here carry Cherng Talay as their primary location: villas and condominiums. International schools and Boat Avenue appear in the project data; distances are measured from the named project.
suitableFor: Buyers seeking value close to Bang Tao
highlights: Within a short drive of Bang Tao, Laguna and Layan
Many villa estates and new condos
Generally lower prices than beachfront areas

lifestyle: Cherng Talay is residential, with local markets, supermarkets, international schools, gyms and attractions such as Blue Tree within easy reach. Most residents drive to the beaches and Boat Avenue.
beaches: The closest beaches are Bang Tao and Layan, typically 1 to 5 km from projects in our catalogue. Surin and Kamala are further south.
rentalMarket: Cherng Talay is mainly a long-term rental market for families and residents who work or study nearby, with some holiday demand for pool villas.

rentalDetails.title: Long-term rentals
rentalDetails.text: Families, teachers and professionals look for villas and condos near schools and the Bang Tao amenities.

rentalDetails.title: Short-term holiday rentals
rentalDetails.text: Pool villas with good facilities can let to holiday groups, but inland locations depend on price and quality.

rentalDetails.title: Suitable property types
rentalDetails.text: Two- to four-bedroom pool villas and practical condos.

rentalDetails.title: Advantages and limitations
rentalDetails.text: Advantage: value and space close to the west coast. Limitations: no beach on foot; heavy new-build supply.

investment: Buyers consider Cherng Talay for more space and lower prices than the beachfront while staying close to Bang Tao and Laguna. It is well suited to family homes and long-term letting.

investmentDetails.title: Typical investor profiles
investmentDetails.text: Families buying a home, buyers of villas for long-term rental.

investmentDetails.title: Risks to consider
investmentDetails.text: Many similar villa estates; check build quality, land title and the developer's completed projects.

investmentDetails.title: Ownership costs
investmentDetails.text: Villa maintenance, pool and garden care, common fees in managed estates, insurance.

faq.question: Where is Cherng Talay in Phuket?
faq.answer: Cherng Talay (Choeng Thale) is a subdistrict in Thalang district on the west coast. It includes the Bang Tao, Laguna, Layan and Surin areas and the inland roads behind them.

faq.question: Is Cherng Talay close to the beach?
faq.answer: Projects in our catalogue are typically 1 to 5 km from Bang Tao or Layan Beach.

faq.question: Is Cherng Talay good for families?
faq.answer: Yes, it is popular with families because of the international schools, supermarkets and clinics nearby and the space of villa estates.

faq.question: How far is Cherng Talay from the airport?
faq.answer: Our project data puts projects about 13 to 21 km from Phuket International Airport.

faq.question: Are villas cheaper in Cherng Talay than in Bang Tao?
faq.answer: Inland villas in Cherng Talay generally have lower starting prices than beachfront or Laguna properties; compare the advertised prices on this page.
